title: 3dcalc
description: AFNI's calculator program. Performs voxel-by-voxel arithmetic on 3D datasets, with strict handling of complex/synthetic inputs and state-dependent flags.

dataset_a.description: Input dataset 'a' (required). This can be a standard file or a synthetic '1D:'/'jRandomDataset:' string. This dataset serves as the template for the output.
dataset_a.title: Dataset A (Template)

cx2r.description: Method to convert complex numbers to real for *this specific dataset*.
cx2r.title: Complex-to-Real Method

variable_letter.description: The variable letter used in the expression (e.g., 'b', 'c').
variable_letter.title: Variable Letter

other_datasets.description: Additional input datasets (b, c, etc.). Includes 'cx2r' support to ensure the flag precedes the specific dataset.
other_datasets.title: Other Input Datasets

expression.description: Arithmetic expression to apply to the input datasets (within quotes).
expression.title: Arithmetic Expression

prefix.description: Use 'pname' for the output dataset prefix name.
prefix.title: Output Prefix

verbose.description: Makes the program print out various information as it progresses.
verbose.title: Verbose Flag

datum.description: Coerce the output data to be stored as the given type.
datum.title: Output Data Type

fscale.description: Force scaling of the output to the maximum integer range (for byte or short output).
fscale.title: Force Scaling

gscale.description: Same as -fscale, but also forces each output sub-brick to get the same scaling factor. Incompatible with -usetemp.
gscale.title: Global Scaling

nscale.description: Don't do any scaling on output to byte or short datasets.
nscale.title: No Scaling

usetemp.description: Create a temporary file to hold intermediate results. Incompatible with -gscale.
usetemp.title: Use Temporary File

dt.description: Use 'tstep' as the TR for 'manufactured' 3D+time datasets (in seconds).
dt.title: Time Step

taxis.description: Force the creation of a time axis. Replaces string input with strict micro-syntax structure 'N:tstep'.
taxis.title: Time Axis Configuration

rgbfac.description: Factors A, B, C for collapsing RGB input datasets (value = A*r + B*g + C*b).
rgbfac.title: RGB Factors

sort_mode.description: Sort each output brick separately. 'sort' = increasing, 'SORT' = decreasing.
sort_mode.title: Sorting Mode

isola.description: After computation, remove isolated non-zero voxels.
isola.title: Remove Isolated Voxels

coordinate_system.description: Set the coordinate display order (DICOM/RAI or SPM/LPI).
coordinate_system.title: Coordinate System Order
